description: Shared scene-expression vocabulary and three pixel-validated pilot contracts. New scenes are compact runtime blueprints rather than duplicate dictionary slots.

topic_intents.text: original adult ability-academy rivalry and practical training

evidence_budget.guidance: one adult academy event, one physical genre clue, and at most one institutional clue

scene_blueprints.subject: two adult rival ability trainees and a mentor at the instant one chooses whether to protect the other
scene_blueprints.action: redirecting an unstable ability burst from a fallen rival while the rescuer's plain rank token visibly dims
scene_blueprints.location: a scarred open-air practical arena in an original adult ability academy
scene_blueprints.prop: a cracked practice focus, one unmarked safety flag, and an impact-scarred floor

scene_blueprints.subject: an adult scholarship trainee and mentor confronting a newly revealed incompatible lineage ability
scene_blueprints.action: steadying a fractured training prism as inherited power changes color and the mentor hesitates over reporting it
scene_blueprints.location: a private original academy aptitude room immediately after a failed adult lesson
scene_blueprints.prop: a fractured neutral prism, a plain scholarship token, and scorched protective gloves

evidence_budget.guidance: one rule-triggering action, one physical consequence, and at most one additional clue, never an icon wall

scene_blueprints.subject: an adult quest returnee and rescued companion at the instant an ability cost becomes visible
scene_blueprints.action: holding a collapsing passage open as one nonverbal status mark fades and strength visibly leaves an arm
scene_blueprints.location: a damaged city underpass at the edge of an unbranded original dungeon breach
scene_blueprints.prop: a cracked rescue token and dropped reward pouch showing the cost

scene_blueprints.subject: an adult quest participant and injured companion before mutually exclusive original system paths
scene_blueprints.action: burning one sealed blank quest token to unlock a safe exit while the richer path closes behind them
scene_blueprints.location: an original forked dungeon threshold with no readable interface or copied iconography
scene_blueprints.prop: one sealed blank token, a closing reward gate, and the companion's damaged gear

evidence_budget.guidance: one adult relationship decision, one physical contract clue, and at most one hierarchy clue

scene_blueprints.subject: an original adult heiress, political fiance, and disgraced ally at a public winter-ball threshold
scene_blueprints.action: returning an unmarked ring to the fiance and stepping beside the ally before the court can react
scene_blueprints.location: a candlelit fictional pseudo-European winter palace ballroom opening onto a snowy terrace
scene_blueprints.prop: a folded blank marriage contract, an unmarked ring, and frost-damp gloves

scene_blueprints.subject: an adult heiress, rival claimant, and wounded estate steward escaping together
scene_blueprints.action: abandoning succession evidence to pull the rival across a collapsing gallery after a nighttime coup
scene_blueprints.location: a storm-damaged original pseudo-European manor with no copied crest or dynasty styling
scene_blueprints.prop: a plain brass succession key, torn blank seal ribbon, and half-submerged account case

scene_blueprints.subject: two adult court athletes as the defender commits to an interception before contact
scene_blueprints.action: reading the attacker's weight shift and cutting into the passing lane one stride before the ball arrives
scene_blueprints.location: a real indoor training court with the playing boundary and both movement paths visible
scene_blueprints.prop: one unbranded ball and two plain training cones marking the narrowing lane

scene_blueprints.subject: a continuous frost-to-melt boundary advancing across one weathered stone face
scene_blueprints.action: revealing branching melt channels as morning light crosses the frost front while the substrate remains visibly continuous
scene_blueprints.location: an exposed stone outcrop with its surrounding slope and scale relationship intact
scene_blueprints.prop: one small unbranded fixed reference peg beside the process boundary

scene_blueprints.subject: an adult conservator and one collection object at the instant a hidden repair edge becomes visible
scene_blueprints.action: pausing stabilization as raking light reveals a lifting surface beside an older repair and choosing where not to press
scene_blueprints.location: a quiet cultural-heritage conservation bench with the object condition central in frame
scene_blueprints.prop: one text-free calibration square, a soft weight, and an unused fine brush beside the anomaly

scene_blueprints.subject: original adult Visual Kei performers and a close live-house audience at the first chord
scene_blueprints.action: the vocalist steps through colored haze as the band strikes the opening chord and the front row surges toward the low stage
scene_blueprints.location: a compact independent live house joining a cramped wing, low stage, and audience floor in one view
scene_blueprints.prop: unbranded instruments, pedals, cables, theatrical makeup, and an abstract unreadable set list

scene_blueprints.subject: a diverse adult tabletop roleplaying group reacting together as one player's choice changes the shared scene
scene_blueprints.action: turning over an unmarked map tile that reveals a blocked escape while the game facilitator and players register the consequence
scene_blueprints.location: an informal home table arranged for an original collaborative roleplaying session
scene_blueprints.prop: generic unbranded dice, blank tokens, and a hand-drawn map with no readable rules text

scene_blueprints.subject: adult community builders guiding an original unbranded lowrider from their workshop toward a neighborhood night display
scene_blueprints.action: lowering the finished car into its display stance as the workshop door opens and waiting neighbors respond
scene_blueprints.location: the threshold between a working community garage and a small public street gathering
scene_blueprints.prop: hand-painted original bodywork, custom upholstery samples, and plain safety chocks without club insignia
